scripts.build: esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.mjs --legal-comments=none --banner:js="import { createRequire as dropCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = dropCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check:dist: npm run build && git diff --exit-code -- dist && test -z "$(git status --porcelain -- dist)"
